title: Task
description: Validates a task description artifact exchanged between agents in the Supervisor-CAO platform. A task declares the work to be performed, its baseline, and the acceptance criteria the result must satisfy. PUBLIC schema: sanitized, contains no secrets, hostnames, or private paths.

task_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the task.

description.description: Natural-language description of the work to be performed.

baseline_sha.description: Git SHA of the baseline (reference) commit the task is measured against.

benchmark_selector.description: Selector expression identifying the benchmark subset to run.

performance_acceptance.description: Performance acceptance criterion the candidate must satisfy.

threshold.description: Numeric threshold value against which the measured metric is compared.

direction.description: Interpretation of the metric: 'lower_better' means values <= threshold pass; 'higher_better' means values >= threshold pass.

regression_threshold.description: Maximum tolerated performance regression relative to baseline, expressed as a fraction (e.g. 0.05 for 5%).

required_test_scope.description: List of test scope selectors (e.g. module paths or markers) that must be exercised.

base_branch.description: Base branch the task branch is created from. Defaults to 'dev'.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp marking when the task was created.
